final_message:
I built the Ploverdesk landing page, but I could not build or type-check it. The sandbox has no Node runtime (`npm` is blocked and there is no `node` binary), so `npm run build` has not been run and the code is not proven to compile. Nobody was available to approve anything, so the theses and design system are my own unvalidated choices.

**What's on the page**
- A headline, a short explanation, the trial button (`/trial`) and a quieter "Book a demo" text link (`/demo`). The button label "Start the 14-day trial" is the same everywhere.
- A table of the three-way match. Each row is one case (everything agrees, wrong quantity, wrong unit price, delivery never arrived) and says what happens to it. The one document that disagrees is marked in amber. On phones the rows stack, with each cell labelled.
- What happens after the match: CSV or API export, hosting in Frankfurt, no user limit.
- The price (290 EUR per month per company), the trial terms, and the same two links again.
- A short company section: founded 2025, six people in Rotterdam, and a plain line saying there are no customer logos or quotes yet.

The only figures on the page are the ones in the brief: 290 EUR, 14 days, 2025 and six people. There are no invented numbers, logos, testimonials or screenshots.

**The design (UNVALIDATED)**
- **Look:** cool white background and dark graphite text. The single amber colour appears only on mismatch cells, never on buttons. Thin borders, 2px corners, no shadows, one left-aligned column.
- **Type:** the device's system font, at two weights. No web font is loaded, so the page makes no requests to other sites, which fits the Frankfurt-hosting message.
- **Motion:** hovers change colour or underline over 120–160ms. Nothing moves on scroll. With the OS "reduce motion" setting on, the transitions are switched off.

**Files written**
- `src/App.tsx`, `src/index.css` and a new `src/tokens.css` holding every colour, size and spacing value.
- `index.html` (title and description).
- `MASTER.md`, the design system, including my assumptions about the brief.
- `preview/thesis.html` and `preview/design-system.html`, two standalone pages showing the direction and the styles. They are throwaway, not part of the site.

**Checks I could run**
- I ran the design-audit script. It reported one finding: hover states with no transition. That's a misread, because the transitions are set on the base rules (`src/index.css:257` and `:285`). None of its 18 checks for stock generated-page patterns, such as invented figures, filler verbs, glow or endless animation, found anything.
- I found one gap by reading the code (the logo link had no hover or pressed state) and fixed it.
- Contrast is calculated from the colour values, not eyeballed: body text 17.3:1, secondary text 7.7:1, small grey text 5.6:1, amber on its background 6.0:1. All pass the accessibility minimum.
- Every interactive element has a visible keyboard focus outline, and both links are at least 44px tall for touch.

**Not verified**
- `npm run build` (TypeScript check plus Vite build).
- How the page looks at phone, tablet and desktop widths, including the stacked table on phones.
- That turning on "reduce motion" in the OS really switches the hover transitions off.
- Animation smoothness in a browser profiler. There is very little to animate, but it hasn't been measured.

There is no favicon or other `public/` asset, and `/trial` and `/demo` are plain links to pages that don't exist yet. I installed nothing. The design-system tool proposed Roboto and GSAP; I declined both because the design needs neither.
